$comment: Owens Corning (roofing shingles and insulation) denies every page fetch from this network: plain HTTP and headless Chrome return ACCESS_DENIED, and AvalAI's page fetch is denied too. So the site uses the default engine (APP_DEFAULT_ENGINE, ai-crawler-avalai on this instance) with ai_fetch web_search; the shop is never contacted and the values are unverified (AI_UNVERIFIED). Engines tried on 2026-11-19: http and browser: ACCESS_DENIED; ai_fetch http and browser: ACCESS_DENIED; web_search: success (5 specs, 4 features, 565+326 tokens). Needs APP_AI_CRAWLER_ENABLED with an AvalAI key.
